plan.summary:
Retry backoff now adds random jitter. This spreads out retries from clients that failed together.

- `backoff(n)` adds `jitter(exponential / 2)` to the exponential delay.
- The result is still capped by `MAX_MS`, so jitter cannot exceed the maximum wait.
plan.riskRationale: One-line change to a delay calculation. Delay is still capped by MAX_MS. No tests appear in the diff, and the behavior of jitter() is not shown.
plan.storyArc: The PR has one change. Retry delays gain randomness so failed clients do not all retry at the same moment, and the cap still bounds the delay.

topics.title: Add jitter to exponential retry backoff
topics.narrativeBrief: How does backoff(n) compute the delay now, and what bounds it? Verify what jitter() returns (range, and whether it can be negative) and that MAX_MS still caps the final value.
